task.instruction: Prioritize the next change for an audio-note capture flow after intermittent draft loss was observed.
task.deliverable: A ranked first action with the rollout posture, fixed safety obligation, and cited evidence.

evidence.content: A synthetic change-boundary review limits this work to local draft persistence and preserves the existing microphone-permission behavior; changing permission scope would be a separate consent change.
In a synthetic 200-session replay, 7 drafts vanished after a background interruption; all 7 were recovered by a bounded local patch.
The recovery patch passed 36 scripted paths, while 4 low-frequency interruption paths have not yet been replayed.

A.content: When the stated risks remain bounded, prefer shorter feedback loops and earlier delivery so evidence can arrive sooner.

B.content: When the stated risks warrant it, prefer stronger verification before commitment so preventable failures are less likely.

irrelevant.content: Prefer section headings that make the final artifact easy to scan.
